name: [[18,12,2]] two-block code over C3 x C3

provenance.construction: Two-block group-algebra code C(a,b) over C3 x C3 = SmallGroup(9, 2) (order 9), elements numbered as in GAP Elements(SmallGroup(order,id)) with element 0 the identity. n = 2|G| = 18; H_X = [L(a)|R(b)], H_Z = [R(b)^T|L(a)^T]; a = {0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 6}, b = {0, 1, 3} as element indices. Check weight 9. Parameters and blocks taken from the public code database of arXiv:2610.13880v1 (Lee, 'Bicycle Race'), github.com/gideonlsx/bicycle-race.
provenance.notes: Parameters and construction taken from the public database of arXiv:2610.13880v1. Distance is an upper bound certified by the witnesses attached here.
